positions.name: RecordedOperationalRule
positions.frame: How are ratified deployment-gate decisions recorded as settled operational rules with named scope and ownership?
positions.why: These three bullets share a single directional read: each performs ratification through compressed label-colon-gist structure, recording the gate (src-4), its scope (src-5), and its owner (src-6) as enacted decisions rather than proposals. Across dimensions they cohere in conviction (decision), register (technical/matter-of-fact), power (legitimate), and relational (authority-ranking) — all attributed to Quinton as principal through Xena's authorship. The rule-of-three structure closes the set as a complete decision record.

positions.name: AuthorityAndJustification
positions.frame: How does authority enact a mandatory deployment gate and supply its empirical justification?
positions.why: Quinton's two direct-speech segments cohere as a paired act: src-1 enacts the gate through present-tense mandate ('now requires'), performing legitimate authority-ranking power; src-2 supplies the empirical rationale ('two unsigned artifacts reach staging last quarter'), shifting to rational-persuasion and plain-spoken register. The tension between enforcement language and evidentiary justification is the group's coherence — authority declared, then grounded in incident.
